Return the bitwise NOT of the expected selector so the return value differs from the original selector.
Return a fixed different selector value (0xdeadbeef) so returned value differs from original selector.
Return caller-dependent value (first 4 bytes of caller address) so return differs based on caller instead of fixed selector.
Replace the assignment to baseToken to instead set baseToken = address(0), forcing baseToken to always be the zero address after initialize.
Replace the assignment to baseToken to instead set baseToken = _nft, making baseToken equal to the nft address after initialize.
Replace the assignment to baseToken to instead set baseToken = msg.sender, causing baseToken to be the initializer caller.
